scope: Complete unmeshed ordered CDF from two disjoint incoming-band warps. Terminal negative M1 is repaired analytically; other changed response families require audit. This is not a game bound or equilibrium.
initial_front_cap: Every warped band uses h_i(min(A_base(U),R_base(psi_i(U),V))); this cap preserves the initial front on bridge intervals and is inactive on the proved repair intervals.
global_source_gates: Each warp is increasing in U, satisfies U<=psi(U)<=1 before U1, and is identity afterward. Disjoint rank-band CDFs preserve the transport cone and total mass.
terminal_ell_gate: The low band repairs [127/128,255/256] and the high band repairs [255/256,1]. The initial-front cap preserves A everywhere. Both additional changes have nonnegative row gain and zero terminal H gain.
all_return_preservation: On the terminal negative-V cone the low band is saturated. The high band gives Dnew>=min(Dbase,12/125), rnew<=rbase, and leaves post e unchanged. Since 12/125>1.9*e(1/128), the audited d>=1.9*min(r,e) gate is preserved.
open_gate: High-band movement can change coarser f/g/I1 and endpoint columns; these costs are not asserted unchanged.
